queries_run: Western Digital HDD market share gaining OR losing 2026
hyperscaler QLC SSD replace nearline HDD Western Digital threat 2026
Seagate HAMR qualified Google hyperscaler 2025 million drives shipped

findings.claim: IDC unit-shipment data through C2Q2025 put Western Digital at 43% HDD market share, Seagate at 40%, and Toshiba at 17%; WDC and Seagate gained share during the year while Toshiba lost share.
findings.source: IDC, 'Worldwide Hard Disk Drive Market Shares, 2025' (my.idc.com/getdoc.jsp?containerId=US54414626)

findings.claim: Seagate has qualified 40TB HAMR (Mozaic 4+) HDDs at two leading data center companies and signed a 44TB Mozaic4+ production deal with a hyperscaler, whereas Western Digital's own roadmap (per its Feb 2026 Innovation Day) shows 40TB UltraSMR ePMR reaching volume production in H2 2026 while HAMR is still in hyperscaler qualification with volume production not starting until 2027.
findings.source: Forbes (Tom Coughlin), 'Seagate Qualifies 40TB HAMR HDDs At Two Leading Data Center Companies'; Blocks and Files, 'Western Digital blows hard disk drive future wide open'

findings.claim: Western Digital's entire 2026 HDD production is sold out, with capacity locked in by hyperscaler/enterprise customers via multi-year agreements extending through 2028; the nearline HDD industry remains a three-player structure (WDC, Seagate, Toshiba) with no reported new entrants.
findings.source: 24/7 Wall St, 'Western Digital Sold Out All 2026 Hard Drive Production as AI Centers Scramble'

Western Digital hyperscaler customer dual source Seagate diversify supplier 2026

findings.claim: Western Digital's sold-out 2026 HDD capacity is allocated mostly to its top seven customers, with long-term supply agreements extending through 2028, giving revenue visibility rather than signs of customers second-sourcing or insourcing this supply near-term.
findings.source: 24/7 Wall St, 'Western Digital Sold Out All 2026 Hard Drive Production as AI Centers Scramble'
